text: After 2000 levels, this game has been officially ruined. Reduced powerups, limited lightning in the expeditions, more expensive in-app purchases than they were before, multiple complaints by players who have been playing for a long long time. This game just lost an immense number of players. Wouldn't recommend it anymore, hopefully it goes back to the way it was, otherwise don't bother installing unless you want to spend a chunk of money to still not manage to pass the levels.

Started playing again. Still not very user friendly, and now with the new upgrade, I've lost my booster's. With the games being very difficult, poor reward system and designed by some evil minded warp toad, it remains to be seen if I'll continue playing. Perhaps the old maxim, if it ain't broke don't fix it, if something they've never heard of?

The ads are totally misleading. If you're here for the advertised minigames, forget it, you'll spend less than 1% of your time on that. It's basically standard "move-blocks-to-rows-so-they-vanish" and after the first levels (teasers) some become ultra hard to do without spending extras (cash). For the advertised minigames? most of them i've never seen after a few hundred levels ingame. but the fish are cute. tl;dr: stay away from this fraud!!

I got kicked out of level 7 of carnival of gifts because of a glitch which I have a screenshot of. There was one scroll 📜 of paper left to find and it was nowhere when all the bottles were open. It could have been alright if I played the game for free but I have purchased diamond to be able to reach this level and the situation does not seem fair to me. One of the worst tech support I have ever seen. If you enter a wrong section to complain - you can't leave it.

First let me just start with the fact this game is not what's advertised. The game once you start playing it can be addictive though. Mostly a fun game to get lost in but some level are just unnecessarily difficult to force you to buy extras for help. Aside from it not being what's advertised, and the huge swings in difficulty from one level to the next, I'd be lying if I said I don't play this game alot despite all that.

The latest update no longer allows the player to restart the level once it's started. It's a tremendously disappointing decision that the game developing team has ever made as it simply discourages players to continue playing the game. It seems the team is running out of ways to squeeze money from players, who used to have the pathetically petty advantage to have the opportunity to start a level in a comparatively painless manner. The fun of the game simply disappeared.

I do love this game. Just passed level 1000 (I know, Welsh lockdown seemed to have gotten to me). I haven't spent a single penny on it. Yes it's very annoying and drives me crazy when I get stuck on a level for weeks at a time but meh so what. Get there eventually. My kids (7&8) love it too. To be honest the only negative is the turtle that talks toy you, you can't skip past to just play levels. But it soenst stop me from coming back

I'm going off this game, sadly. I've played it for years but I'm unhappy with the last update. The changing of the bombs and combos you can start with. It's made it harder to complete levels, I'm guessing that was the point, we're completing levels faster than you can make them? I miss the fishy side games too. The explorer map games are getting boring, they could be replaced with longer versions of the little games that were stopped. Please make this game better again.

This game is a scam. The minigames they advertise are only available after spending lots of time playing another game that is not advertised. It is the same like Evoy The king returns. They are a game much different than the game they advertise. So, if you watched the ads of the fish eating other fishes and you think that is all this game is gonna be, you gonna be fooled. If that were the main game, it would be ok. But the main game is another different thing. Not what you see in the ads.

Firstly, the ads for this game make it look like a simple maths puzzle game when in reality it's actually just a match 3 game with "mini games", not as advertised. Also, I had to uninstall a bunch of things to have enough space to play this, then after playing for an hour or so and then coming back to it later, I suddenly needed more than twice as much extra space as I needed to install in the first place. Uninstalled.

The adverts for this game are missleading. The game is not what you expected from the ads. This is a basic match three type of game. I am horrified that this kind of false advertising still goes on. The game is not impressive. rather dull actually. If you advertise a certain type of game, please deliver. I have had the same experiences from your other games. All falsley advertised. Not impressed and will not recomend. shame on you!

Just another pay to play app. It's fun enough but there comes a point when you can't progress without spending money. I was happy to buy this game on Big Fish Games for a fixed price but this is ridiculous. Uninstalled. Thanks Devs your money grubbing got you precisely NOTHING. Oh and the mini games are pathetic. You can just keep trying until you get it right.

Very interesting game. Beautiful graphics and each aquarium has lovely different designs which you can decorate, so don't go buying everything that pops up. Take your time and choose what belongs in each aquarium. Some improvements can be made with regards to the rewarding system. All in all I'm very happy with it and it got me off my Candy Crush addiction.

Excellent game, fun to play and although it can take quite a few go's to beat levels, it is possible to do so, without purchasing any jewels. The tasks can enable you to build up coins and jewels. The new teams are a great idea - but it's a shame the levels are based on your current level on fishdom. I think it would've been better if it was a separate game and team members could build up scores from playing team games / feeding fish, with rewards in the form of bombs etc instead of just lives.

Just at level 4, the game froze and would not respond. I clicked every possible button but it wouldn't navigate me anywhere. When I tried to go on with the puzzle it wouldn't let me because I had finished all my prompts but it wouldn't let me pass onto the next level either. I only downloaded it for old times sake when it used to be that one game with the fish trying to eat each other but I didn't even get to play it because of this bs.

Hopeless - ads show great game, but what you get is an hour before you get ONE GAME, followed by another, seemingly endless non-essential stuff, then another ONE GAME. THIS REPEATS, ON, AND ON. Don't even think of installing, will end up uninstalling. This applies ALL SIMILAR TO THE SO-CALLED, GAMES - I FINALLY SAW THE BIT ABOUT THIS, was barely can see it, disappears in 0.0005 seconds! Could, if I do, give 0-Stars.

I absolutely love decorating aquariums idea. But levels are IMPOSSIBLE to clear, EVEN IF I USED BOOSTERS. And minigames THAT THEY USED TO ADVERTISE THE APP can BARELY seen in the actual game. I can only say this because I actually constantly in a few days. Maybe if the developer use less budget in advertisement, they wouldn't be this greedy and people can actually enjoy the game. IF YOU'RE NOT BORN RICH, RUN!

Money grab, and just getting more greedy each update. No more lightning w/ dynamite, no more mini games, smaller rewards during expeditions, prices jumping and the way they label levels is inaccurate: sometimes a "super hard" level is easy, making you waste boosters. They used to tell you the goal for the level so you could get an idea of how hard it really was, not any more. THEN when you email to complain, they say "It improves the balance of game, giving players more chances to win" LIES

I've played for years and it was fun. The last couple of months, I have to play for about 5 days to win one level. When choosing lightning or bombs, it get placed on a spot where it's inaccessible, or get frozen immediately and cannot be used until the last 3 moves. Why do u make it so hard? It get super boring after the second day of playing the same board. Losing interest and I've been playing for YEARS!

Firstly, I have been playing fishdom for 11 years, and it is my favorite game, but now the levels are impossible to beat. There are too many objectives with too few moves. The prices of things have also gotten out of hand. I'm at level 16415 now, and I can not seem to get further. This game was really fun for a long time, but now the game is just too much. Playrix, please fix this problem, and please make everything cheaper. Thank you

I'm on the level where you race other players to the finishing line. Since I have started it only yesterday the game no longer works. I can't play anything. I've lost 10 hours of 3 playing. It won't even let me contact help. It is not responding to anything. I have uninstalled and installed it more than once. I've shut it down and restarted it. Nothing has changed. Worked so hard with my team only for it to just not work. So angry 😠 right now. If I could, I wouldn't even give it 1 star. Fix it.

Another game where the advert is a tiny portion of the game you're forced to play. I just wanted to be a little fish eating bigger and bigger fish, but that was one minigame in ten, with the main game unable to choose whether it's offbrand candy crush, offbrand Spyro the dragon, or an aquarium decoration zone. Super misleading and frustrating in the long run.

I'm changing my review. This has been my favourite game for over the last year or two, but recently there have been negative changes to the additional boosts, particularly the seahorse that comes around every few days. I have a policy of not paying actual money for games. I just play until I've exhausted all possibilities. I've reached that point now. I used to be able to win on skill/patience, but now it feels like I'm being 'encouraged' (forced) to pay. I think I'm done with Fishdom.

Not sure how many stars to give the game really. I have uninstalled the game yet again after being on level 5211. I've played this game for a few years now and its always my go back to game, but if you like a game of skill don't bother, having played it for so long now ive seen so many times how it can keep you on a level for a few days before it decides to let you complete it. Today I had completed a level but told me I still had one more item to collect so couldn't progress.

Got baited. Downloaded after viewing several ads showing a seemingly interesting puzzle game, but the first 15 levels are just a cheap candy crush rip-off, coupled with a boring tutorial component presumably geared towards getting the player to engage with the store. Unfortunately this type of game baiting has become all too common these days, but I suppose that's to be expected with developers struggling to monetise apps in the free-to-play economy. Just a prime example of a sad reality.

I downloaded this game because I saw it's Ad many times in my other games. Unfortunately this game it NOT AT ALL as advertised. I have experienced this with a lot of games advertised in other apps where the advertisement looks fun then you download it and they are all basically the same as candy crush but you earn coins to build an aquarium and buy fish. Same as in Gardenscapes but you build a house instead. Decent games but fix the completely false advertising please.

I have not installed this game in particular but I have downloaded similar one gardenscapes. Please remember this that the ads of these games make it look so easy. But in fact you need coins to perform each activity and you win each coin by clearing some levels of candy crush like game within this game. Difficulty increases level by level and the player will be given limited options if they fail a level, which I find annoying. So, I am not interested in this game and I won't download.

ORIGINAL POST very addictive. Can't stop playing it. Doesn't get boring as always extra side games to play. Can require in app purchases though to clear higher levels. EDIT I would now suggest that you avoid this app. It takes a lot of money to get through many of the levels levels now. The developers have reduced the number of moves available so it is becoming even more difficult to pass a level - and it's almost impossible to progress through the levels without spending money to get boosters etc. No longer fun when you spend hours/days or weeks just to pass one level Lots of people online saying the same thing.

Really enjoy the game. But there is sometimes an issue with the controls. If I swipe the piece one direction, it goes another direction and completely messes up my plan and I'm unable to complete the level in that round, where if it allowed the piece to go the direction I requested, I would gain a bomb, or the bomb would explode where I need it to. Please fix this, because it's highly annoying

fish bank should be free!!!! does not make sense to collect it full and than only to buy what you collected!!!! seriously this game is getting boring as well it's like repeating the levels at different levels again, be more creative with the stages add new challenges or make transitions in the pieces or something! anything! and FISHBANK SHOULD BE OPEN FOR FREE!!!! WE COLLECTED IT, ITS OURS!!!!!! because I will never buy it no matter what its ridiculous who spends money on a game cummon!

Great game but some not so great updates. They changed the power ups so where you once got a lightning and dynamite combined, you only get a dynamite now. So everyone who bought these would have lost value when it changed. It has made some levels almost impossible without buying loads of extras, but I guess that's why they've done it. It would be good if you could buy power ups and diamonds using the coins you earn instead of diamonds that cost physical money.

I downloaded this as I saw it from an ad (didn't click on ad) those ads and what the game is are two very different things I should have known better. In any case this was not want o thought it would be. I thought you go around and eat bigger fish and level up it is not it's basicay like jewel blitz. I uninstalled won't reinstall. I wish you could just play the "mini games"

Nothing like the ad that convinced me to try it. Really rather silly which is fine but I found it hard to figure out even the most basic level and it was super boring. I really would have liked to play the game in the ad where you try to navigate the fish through a maze, by trying to direct it safely and avoid danger but I guess I'm too dumb to get to that level because I couldn't even figure out level 1, which doesn't even have a fish and involved clearing coins like in bejeweled. Uninstalled:(

Just uninstalled. Really fun and addictive game. Puzzles are well done and are fun to complete. At some levels you are given a ridiculously low amount of moves just to make sure you waste all your boosts and bonuses, or have to purchase some. Sometimes I feel the bonuses at the beginning of the levels are more like a nuisance in they way they are placed. I've wasted enough time on this and I'm sure the devs won't miss me since I didn't have them a penny. It was fun while it lasted.

What is with all the glitches all of a sudden!!!!! Why do i have to re log into facebook, i never logged out, and I've never put in my facebook password before so please fix it!!!! Fishdom, the game with 45 pop ups before you can feed your fish! Cute game, some levels are Very very hard! Quite hard to get 3 stars on each tank also, and too much to put in tank before you get another star, it's looking too crowded! Please make it an offline game

I ❤️ this game!! It's so much fun to play the levels and gained coins and vouchers to decorate the tanks. Rewards are good after winning levels, completed tidal tasks, joined the challenges and even small tasks like feeding the fish and clean up the aquarium. The only downside is the gold voucher is very rare so it is annoying to have to wait for so long to buy the special fish. But in overall this game is highly recommended.

Sadly it's a Pay-to-win game. Once you cross 80+ levels, you are going to have a hard time progressing. Events are a good way to get perks, which will help you to advance multiple levels at ease, but the problem is to progress in event, you need to complete the levels you stuck in. Sometimes you will get rewards at the wrong time and you can't do anything because you don't have any more lives to play. This game is heavily dependent on micro transactions. And it's not cheap!

Was a great game but have to agree with the majority here. It's too many hard levels forcing you to buy items to get through. And now it 9 gems to carry on a game instead of 6. Sigh. When you Google how to get through a level the examples are often the same level but with more moves. They seem to make it harder than the original level just to show it can be done and then they make it almost impossible but cutting the move count.

I've played for a long time and I dont pay to play. Never have, never will! Some levels are near impossible to get through and trying to beat the level for days on end is BORING, un-inviting, a turn-off and absolutely frustrating. It's disgusting that many levels have dropped in the number of moves. Terrible game play by the developers!

Its a good game. But there is some miss advertising.. the main thing they showed that got me interested is not what the game is about. Actually that really ever happens.. where you get to choose a pin to pull and save or endanger the fish.. However it's a captivating game. I deleted it because at one point you will no longer be able to pass levels unless you put in your credit card info and pay for lives and advantages.

Not happy 😔 I've been playing this game for a few years and always enjoyed it until recently, so many changes and not for the better! I've always bought the Gold Pass but not any more, they've lowered the rewards considerably and yet the price stays the same! Who wants to pay the same amount of money and get less for it 😡 come on Playrix stop being so greedy! EDIT: yet another week long pass for the same price as the monthly one!! I will not spend any more money until this changes!!

I've been playing this for years and used to really enjoy it plus buy passes each month. However, they've made it so difficult; cut game pass time and jacked the price. You can't pass later levels without buying boosters, despite them saying they can all be beaten without boosters, is just an outright lie. Even 1 hr free playing and you can't pass without boosters? it's not even fun anymore, it's just GREED. Don't waste your time. Sucks you in for money...

Best aquarium-style game I've found. Love the new Aquatasks update. No shortage of goals to achieve. Really enjoyed this game since I started. I like how you can customize each aquarium and the variety of fish to collect. Ability to customize each aquarium is almost endless. Many levels are just challenging enough and a few are very difficult but definitely keeps the game interesting.

This is a great game, but I feel the developers have just gotten too greedy, They changed the gold tickets from $10.99AUD a month to now $7.99 a week! You can't pass some levels without spending money, I've spent so much on this game, and they just keep making things harder or adding more cost to the game. I will keep playing for now, but I refuse to spend anymore money on the game just to line the developers pockets.

Love the game, i dread to think about the amount of money I would spend to advance in the game, give the poor people a chance, the way things are going the world is doomed, keef.. well I can Admit it was not the case of the end of the world. There is still a chance. I've got a sore thumb trying to advance the game.slow going with not spending any money. Update, I have found out that it costs £1200 to complete all the levels. I don't spend money on games. I don't know if it is value for money.. x

I love this game as I've played it for years but I'm so disappointed as I feel they have gotten greedy with their prices. You used to get 50 credit but now 30 credit for the same price and also you are not getting the deal or credit the same price as before they have risen the prices up. I won't be buying the credits while they are expensive. Such a shame as it was my favourite all time game. Did think on unistalling due to their greed.

Not the game I signed up for so this in itself is this was deceptive. Like mentioned in numerous feedback, game needs a lot of time for cleaning tanks etc. Some levels are impossible without buying packs. I deleteeld the game as I was receiving intrusive sound push notifications at all hours. After I deleted it, I received heavy advertising on Flipboard to "Come back" which I deemed to be inappropriate & flagged as such. Now they are back with no option to flag only download. So Wrong!

The game was promoted as a puzzle where slides were pushed or pulled to move water or poison to a keep a fish alive, or to kill it. Whereas the actual game is just another version of Candy Crush where you clear levels to collect coins to buy fish, weeds and ornaments for your aquarium. I played 32 levels and then deleted it. Although graphics were good, I'm disappointed that this is not the game that i thought I'd be playing!

Completely addictive for all the RIGHT reasons. Plus the characters are cuties. UNFORTUNATELY it is a EXPENSIVE game to play - oftentimes the only option for winning a game is to purchase & use combo bombs, etc. - . Past year the game improved immensely - more chances to earn those needed rewards that are helpful in game play. Delightful new aquarium's and characters. Definitely ENJOYABLE experience & endless hour's of ENTERTAINMENT. Great game, thank you.

Too expensive app. Fishy bank for £ 2.99? I tried once, no more. Lot of levels too difficult and if you have no boosters (very hard to get them) you have no chance to level up without pay...Or just wait 2.5 hours to get your lives in full. I really like messages as " Don't give up, you can do it... " YES, ALL YOU NEED TO DO IS PAY, AND PAY AND PAY... Or christmas sale message: unlock the whole picture to get reward. Yes, all you need to do is pay again. At this time £17. Very disappointed...

Misleading ad sucks you in, i wanted to play the game shown in the ad not what i ended up playing. Then they make the levels near impossible to complete and you have to keep trying, which is fine its a game with less boosters. Or spend money to get more. The boosters are randomly placed throughout the puzzle and half the time you cannot use them, based on their placement, and they cant be moved to where you need them... it became frustrating so i deleted it.

I used to really like the game , but since the last update it has changed ...and not for the better. The bonus' has changed you get less for winning a level...if you can even pass a level.. the energy you get for the expeditions has dropped and the amount of energy needed to continue has gone up. I have played for years but seriously not anymore.. Updates are supposed to add to the games...not take away.

I am getting more & more frustrated & disappointed with this game that i once loved. Now just about every level is hard or super hard. The amount of moves are ridiculously low & most of the time half of the moves shown on the Youtube tutorial. I have sent queries to support which take nearly a week for feedback but this does not resolve the issue.

Is a great game however the waiting in between for lives in order to play was way too long then you lose interest. Very very frustrating ! Many other games to play that you can play continously. I uninstalled and so has my family. 5* for the fish but 1* for the waiting for lives. They could go for advertisements instead of having to pay..as another option. Angry birds has other options to play while waiting for new lives... More options. So it's a pass for me . Needs improvements. For 5*

I'm re-rating since the season pass has increased, and the game difficulty has increased, thus adding pressure to buy more boosts. The game is now frustrating. Previously, it was almost impossible to complete everything with the season pass at 10.99 AU; now it is 14.99 AU and you get less powerups and down graded power ups in the shells. It's an expensive game when compare it to better quality PC & console games, at a one time cost for the entire game. Shame, it was fun when away from the PC.

Thought that this would be an interesting game that is quite different from most games on the market. False advertising! There are no save the fish puzzles or riddles, just a boring match 3(etc) game. If one could give a zero star or negative star review, that's exactly what I would do! Uninstalling with immediate effect!

Fun and challenging game. Definitely recommend it, but refuse to give 5 stars due to a recent upgrade where you have to purchase diamonds that YOU have earned in game play. Annoying! Additional: Please stop making the achievement of special seasonal characters dependant on movement through the levels!! They should solely be available by "purchase" with the special tokens (eg. bell's in the Christmas event), irrespective of the level you are on! 15/2/19:Each update worsens the game!

I am uninstalling the game simply because it gets too hard to win a level it's frustrating when you spend an hour to no avail. Also when the triangle comes up it always goes to the farthest possible corner it almost becomes useless to have. Especially if you have two of them and try to hit them together it goes so far away from that other one. The game sometimes gets too difficult to play, I mean come on this is supposed to be fun not a source of stress

Really disappointed with the resent changes to this game. For start the price of the ticket events. The ticket event are much shorter time for the same money. You used to be able to collect diamonds in these events that felt like a side hussle, now you are award a set amount. You also used to get set tasks which were an enjoyable challenge. All gone. I can't afford 4.49 for up grades every 2 weeks and without them I get stuck for days. I'm not enjoying it anymore.

Very addictive and well designed app. But really frustrating to have to wait for such long times and so often before you can play again. Use ads to make money as I'm about to uninstall as I have no intention of having to pay for lives as you cannot exchange any coins you've collected and are forced to spend physical cash vs your 'virtual' coins/cash. Still disappointed on how similar each level is...I'm on 33 (originally reviewed on level 20 and the levels haven't changed) 😴

Loved the game!! Been playing for a couple of years now so keep having to wait for new games now, the trouble is it stops you from getting gold even if you beat the treasure game the developers use, you also cannot compete for anything else such as pearls etc. I think the developer should at least let you win gold and compete with others so the game can be still enjoyed as it has started to bore me as it is. Therefore I move my rating from a 5star to 3star.

Started really fun, the game is really addictive and the best part is there are no ads. But here comes the tricky part. As you advance the game, it becomes pay-to-play, and as soon as you bought something the game will target you and makes it impossible for you to advance without boosters. Great potential that ended up being disappointing. Also, the last season event, firework festival, cannot be completed without buying gems, since you are running out of giftwrap set. That was the end for me.

False advertising. Gameplay is NOTHING like the ad but is instead a run-of-the-mill M3 game where you have to move shells and starfishes around a board and match them up. With the points you earn you can tidy up your fake ocean home. It's also designed to hook you and keep you playing, wasting your time and thinking the virtual world is important, Tamagochi-style.

For me, I installed it on my Samsung Galaxy, and on my Lenovo tablet, and it was the same glitch. I went to minigames, there was nothing. I tried again, same thing. It also lost my progress. I was on level 20, then my battery died. I went to recharge it, but when I went back into the game, I was on level 5! Uninstalled. Please fix the glitches. Overall, medium, but would give it 5 stars if you fixed the problems.

Average. This game is not anything like the one advertised. It's a form of Candy Crush which is entertaining but not what was advertised. Annoying features include limited lives unless you pay $$ for add-ons but, can be played without and, it wants to constantly insist on team play but, you can ignore it. Minor irritations include the ability to only choose your boosters at the beginning of a game not, when you actually need them, which means you often get forced to use them before you want to.

Game is 10% what was advertised to me from another game. Only thing in common with this game and the one advertised is that it's about fish. I'm not sure how you can get away with advertising something that resembles a escape room puzzle and then the game is pay to play candy crush. But if your marketing team doesn't look into it soon I'm sure someone will sue for false advertising.

I got this game on the pretend of false advertisement about saving a fish. But boy the game I got instead is phenomenal!!! This has been the best game I have ever played on my phone! I look forward to signing on every day. But also because they have beautiful graphics and give their fish such charming and kind personalities. I am dealing with a lot of stress and anxiety, and playing Fishdom helps relieve that. The little fishies and decorations are so pretty. Thank you so much.

This is not like the ad, you don't gobble up other fish in any way. It's a match 3, with side quests. Kind of like Homescapes without the house to fix. Why they do that is bizarrely puzzling because it's a pretty good game, just nothing like the ad whatsoever. That's why it's getting 1 star. It's fun and all, but blatant lying on their ads is just stupid and deceitful.

Game is fun to begin with but then becomes annoying and boring pretty quickly. levels become to challenging very early (considering how many levels there are) and you burn through lives rapidly and then have to wait 30 minutes to gain 1 life back to try again. if you want more than 1 attempt after your lives are gone, you'll be waiting hours to do it. spend more time waiting to play the game than you do actually playing the game itself.

Latest changes are AWFUL. I really hope fishdom actually TAKE NOTICE of everyone's comments on Facebook. I've been playing for years (level 15735) but these changes are awful - reduced bonuses, only one bomb/TNT, no extra goes after beating 3 games, only able to build up 100 points on the expeditions before it stops accruing, getting so expensive to actually equip an aquarium to move on. Some games are so complicated now you have no chance of beating them in the number of goes allowed etc. 😡

meh. its meh. could be worse. not very good either. another pay to win ad farm that copies other games. ads for it only show the random puzzle levels you get(lvls that give half or less rewards mind you) needs a lot of work to make it more user friendly and actually a fun game

False advertisement, is nothing like the ads, all games from this developer are not as advertised. I suggest everybody to report this developer there is a option for that on the top of the page. If gets enough reports they may finally put this thing down. There is no fish to be saved, the garden game is the same thing, nothing to save, just another generic matching 3 game. Reported just like all the other games for false advertisement.

Fix!the!!game!Since the new update I can't play it its just frozen.I rerestarted it twice and still can't play it ,I have enough space on the phone too,before the forced update everything was ok!. I can log in but then I can't do anything more it's really disappointed because I now passed valentinsevent and I had 1200 roses😠fix this problem i invested a lot of money for a game that I can't play now..also no answer from your support even after I write 3 emails😠plus my level 1750 just disappeare

This a great game. Addictive but also frustrating at times. But I would ask the developers why if I buy a pack with say 2hrs unlimited lives that time has to be used straight away? I understand if you get it free as a bonus it would start straight away. But if I pay for it surely I should be able to use it at my convenience. And if I have to come out of the app for whatever reason the time should stop so that i can come back and enjoy the time i have paid for.

Game is OK, no more challenging than other games, but it is NO WHERE near presented the way that it is advertised. Very misleading... You advertise gold and sell silver instead. Not sure how long I'll keep it on the device but not at all like it is advertised. May uninstall and play my other games that DON'T MISLEAD their gamers!! You're bait and switching unsuspecting people. 😔👎👎

I wish I could post a screenshot on my level. I'm already at 3,119 and yeah it took me this long because I really love the game. But then it becomes so difficult that I can barely finish each level now. The moves are so few like it's really not enough to finish the game. I have also observed that since the moves are just few, bonus explosives are all exhausted. I saw that this game just merely wants me to but everything. It's becoming pretty much discouraging too, I'm getting bored as time goes

Frankly speaking i came to know about this game through ads, where i m supposed to save the fish by solving some maze like puzzles. That seemed like quite fun. So i downloaded the game and it turned out to be damned tile matching game! I totally felt like being deceived.
